static_traits.name: Gao Lei
static_traits.educational_background: Has attended cooking courses and workshops
static_traits.family_status: Lives with roommates, Not mentioned regarding family of origin
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive roommate, but the relationship is affected by self-isolation
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problem history; has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly organized, highly cooperative; able to self-reflect and notice thought patterns; emotional tone leaning anxious

basic_info.main_problem: I recently did not pass the cooking competition audition, so I feel Depression and Anxiety about future opportunities. The problem began when the audition results were announced last month, and gradually developed into assuming everyone dislikes my performance based on their expressions.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of Depression affect my motivation and confidence in pursuing a culinary career. I hope to practice replacing negative thoughts with more realistic ones, and seek strategies for managing Anxiety and improving sleep.
growth_experiences: In past culinary learning experiences, Gao Lei received positive feedback in cooking courses, and friends and family often liked his dishes. These successful experiences prove he has certain cooking skills and potential, but they tend to be overlooked in higher-pressure judging scenarios.

Last month he auditioned for a cooking competition and did not pass. The audition was highly stressful; after the results were announced, Gao Lei kept recalling the judges' expressions and on-site details, interpreting them as 'they do not like me', producing significant Depression and Anxiety about future opportunities, affecting Work performance, interpersonal interactions (self-isolation), eating habits and sleep.

core_beliefs: I will not succeed in my culinary career

special_situations.event: After the cooking competition audition results were announced, seeing the judges' expressions and interactions with each other
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the judges' expressions are unfriendly or they look at each other, it means they hate my work and my performance was terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replaying on-site details with Self-denial, while reducing communication with roommates to avoid being judged; trying to suppress Anxiety with 'staying positive'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They all dislike my performance; I let them down

special_situations.event: Thinking of future auditions or new opportunities in the culinary field
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot pass in one try or perform perfectly, it proves I am not fit to be a Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating on preparation, reducing practice investment; trying to fight Anxiety with positive self-suggestion but with limited effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure means I will not succeed in the future either

special_situations.event: Recalls the judges' expressions and silence at the audition, lacking clear feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When I cannot read others' expressions, I should assume the worst outcome
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding proactively seeking feedback, to reduce Anxiety in facing uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They have already decided I am bad

special_situations.event: Roommates are willing to support, but I hesitate whether to express Depression and Anxiety to them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express negative feelings, others will think I am weak or troublesome
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Chooses self-isolation and reduces communication to avoid possible negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not want to hear my troubles

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and affirmed (seen and appreciated in one's professional field)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged and rejected, fearing being negated after failure and losing professional self-worth
defense_goal: Avoiding the risk of being negated by staying cautious and distant
Reducing Anxiety and uncertainty through rational analysis and self-control

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough person being judged who may be negated at any time

object_relations.object_representation: Supportive others who may not want to hear negative emotions

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks 'what evidence do you have that everyone dislikes your performance' and invites considering other possibilities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing the counselor's inquiry as questioning my abilities, as if being judged again (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, supportive tone, using open-ended questions, guiding him to focus on present feelings and bodily reactions, while pulling inferences back to concrete facts and evidence, avoiding confrontation and judgment.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing others' neutral or unclear expressions and Silence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting inner Self-denial as 'they dislike me'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Distinguishing 'guesses' from 'facts' in a curious and non-judgmental way, inviting reality testing (seeking specific feedback), and reinforcing the possibility of diverse Interpretations.

manifestations: Regarding one failed audition as an overall judgment of ability and professional worth
Overlooking past successes and strengths, sinking into worries about future opportunities
outcomes: Sleep difficulties and changed eating habits

manifestations: Has supportive roommates yet hesitates to express emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Mind-reading-style belief that judges and others 'all dislike me'
Interpreting neutral expressions as negative evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-denial ('I am not good enough')
Hesitates to express feelings to roommates, worries about being seen as weak or troublesome

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Reduces communication with roommates, turns support needs into self-endurance
When frustrated, turns energy toward self-blame rather than seeking help outwardly

exception_events.target_problem: When facing judging or social evaluation situations, Gao Lei usually jumps to conclusions based on others' expressions, developing Depression and Anxiety, and tending toward self-isolation.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In one cooking course work showcase, Gao Lei received positive feedback and did not engage in negative speculation as usual, instead experiencing recognition and more stable confidence.
exception_events.reason: Clue: at the time the task was clear, feedback was timely and based on specific criteria; the environment was more supportive, evaluation focused more on skills; therefore a more realistic self-assessment and lower Anxiety emerged this time.

positive_force: Past positive feedback from cooking courses and family/friends, possessing skills and successful experience
Willing to accept counseling, positive attitude; willing to practice reality testing and cognitive restructuring
Has supportive roommates and a social support network
Able to identify and begin challenging 'mind-reading/black-and-white' thinking
negative_force: Jumping to conclusions (mind reading) and black-and-white cognitive patterns
Highly dependent on external evaluation, ignores evidence of one's own objective ability
Anxiety and sleep problems affecting daily functioning and motivation

antecedent: Thinking of future auditions or new opportunities
Recalling the judges' expressions and silence during the audition
Triggered by failure- and negation-related cues
target_behavior.core_reason: Avoiding based on mind-reading inferences (others will negate me) and Fear of Being rejected/shame
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and uncomfortable emotions (briefly easing Anxiety)
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged Interpersonal relationships, Reduced social support, Decreased drive, maintained Depression and Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep difficulties (difficulty falling asleep, Declining sleep quality)
antecedent: Repeatedly thinking about the audition failure and future opportunities before sleep
Rising Anxiety, worrying the future will not bring success
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic worries about future failure and hypervigilance maintaining physiological arousal
target_behavior.function: Unintentional function; briefly maintaining vigilance to cope with subjective threats
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased energy, Work performance affected, changed eating habits, further weakening motivation and emotional stability
